The format search has not recorded any tensor's own error in its format yet. Measured on 2 models with a format search (of 263 surveyed).

Model outputs keep a median 18.1 dB SQNR against full precision, the worst 13.3 dB (mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k). 1 of 2 models with a prediction metric (top-1, perplexity or agreement) lose some of it; the most: stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5 (token agreement 100% → 92%: the share of token positions whose predicted token matches full precision's).

Separately, the error accumulated along the data path (every tensor before a node quantized too): linear outputs end furthest from full precision, mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k keeping only 4.2 dB there.
